jobs.occupation: Controller (m/f/d) European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance (Leiter/in - Controlling)
jobs.description:
Job Description: Techtronic Industries (TTI) is a world leader in
cordless technology spanning power tools, accessories, hand tools,
outdoor power equipment, as well as floorcare & cleaning products. Our
focus is on end-users that range from professionals in the industrial,
construction and infrastructure sectors to DIYers in home improvement,
repair, and maintenance. TTI’s powerful brand portfolio includes
MILWAUKEE®, RYOBI®, AEG® ̶ recognized worldwide for their deep
heritage and innovative product platforms of superior quality. The
company maintains a global manufacturing and product development
footprint, with record world-wide sales of approximately US$15.2
billion and around 50,000 employees in 2026. Hiring exceptional people
is a top focus at TTI. This drives a high-performance culture across
all levels of our organization and helps to achieve our vision of
being number one in the industries we serve. Our unique high-speed
decision-making process supports our acute focus on developing
superior products and meeting high customer expectations. We view our
winning culture as a competitive advantage that powers our growth. As
part of a structured succession planning process at our Winnenden
(Stuttgart area) site, we are looking for a Controller (m/f/d)
European Logistics & Supply Chain Finance who is motivated to take on
increasing responsibility and further develop their career within an
international environment. In this role, you will work closely with
the current Team Lead and gain comprehensive insight into the
financial steering of our European logistics organization. Over time,
you will be systematically introduced to broader responsibilities and
leadership-related tasks. This position offers a clear perspective to
assume the Team Lead role for European Logistics & Supply Chain
Finance in the future as part of our long-term succession planning.
Your responsibilities: Logistics cost controlling: partner closely
with the logistics organization to perform budget-to-actual analyses,
ad hoc evaluations, scenario analyses, and management reporting
Budgeting & forecasting: prepare annual budgets, periodic forecasts,
and financial outlooks Closing activities: support month-end and
year-end closing processes Management reporting: prepare, analyze, and
continuously improve monthly management reports and KPIs Support the
strategic planning of European logistics operations and develop
business cases for the development of the European warehouse footprint
Inventory controlling: analyze inventory levels, inventory variances,
rework and scrapping activities to track financial impacts and
identify risks and opportunities Projects & process improvements:
participate in international and cross-functional projects with a
focus on enhancing controlling processes, reporting standards, and
digital tools Leadership exposure: collaborate closely with the
current Team Lead, gaining insight into leadership responsibilities,
stakeholder management, and strategic decision-making processes Your
profile: Degree in Business Administration, Finance, Business
Informatics, Industrial Engineering, or a comparable qualification
Relevant experience in Controlling, Finance, or a related analytical
business partnering role, ideally in an international environment
Business analytical skills, interest in numbers and data, and the
expertise to translate financial insights into business
recommendations Competent knowledge of Excel and BI tools; SAP
knowledge as a plus Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented
working style combined with collaboration skills Communication and
stakeholder management skills across different organizational levels
Interest in taking on additional responsibility and developing toward
a leadership position Good command of German and English Willingness
to travel according to business need within Europe What we offer: An
interesting position with an attractive company––recognized as a
"top employer” by kununu A genuine succession opportunity: This
position has been created as part of a long-term succession plan. You
will work closely with the current Team Lead and be systematically
prepared for broader responsibilities and a potential future
leadership role. A challenging and impactful role within an
international organization and a highly motivated team The opportunity
to actively shape and further develop our European Logistics & Supply
Chain Finance Controlling organization Flexible working hours, hybrid
working options, and 30 days of annual leave Capital-forming benefits
and company pension scheme EGYM Wellpass corporate fitness membership
Employee discounts, JobRad bicycle leasing, complimentary fruit, water
and coffee, and additional attractive benefits Are you interested?
Then send your application stating your earliest possible starting
date and your salary expectations to jobs@tti-emea.com or apply
directly via our careers page. Naturally, we will treat your
application with the utmost discretion. We look forward to getting to
know you! Techtronic Industries ELC GmbH Human Resources – Agnese
Cesarini · Max-Eyth-Straße 10 · 71364 Winnenden

About Deutsche Telekom AG
You are at home in the world. So are we — in more than 50 countries across the globe. We connect work and life, and our products enrich people's everyday experiences. Deutsche Telekom is one of the largest telecommunications providers in Europe and the first choice in the gigabit society. We have the best network and 230,000 innovative minds. Become one of them.
** **
Products.Innovation.Experience. at Deutsche Telekom
For people who want to build more than products: real impact.
At Deutsche Telekom, we develop digital products, services and platforms used by millions of people across Europe every day. Within our Products.Innovation.Experience. department, we bring together product management, engineering, design, data and AI to build experiences that are simple, intelligent and relevant at scale. We are looking for a Lead Design Systems (m/f/d) to join our Design & Customer Experience team and drive the evolution of a shared design foundation that enables quality, consistency and scale across Telekom’s products and services.
** **
**What We Provide **

- Value-based innovation culture that unites creativity, responsibility and purpose.
- International and diverse team collaborating across domains and locations.
- Meaningful projects with global customer impact.
- Creative environment that encourages experimentation and collaboration.
- Continuous learning and career development opportunities.
- Onsite in Bonn, Berlin or Darmstadt

**What You'll Do **
As Lead Design Systems (m/f/d ) you define and evolve the vision and strategy for Telekom’s design system together with Design, Engineering and Product leadership. You drive design system initiatives across cross-functional teams while providing expert design leadership and have further tasks such as:

- Own and evolve components, tokens, patterns and guidelines to ensure consistency, quality and accessibility.
- Enable designers, engineers and product teams to adopt, contribute to and continuously improve the design system.
- Balance standardization with flexibility, enabling innovation within shared foundations.
- Champion accessibility and inclusive design as core principles.
- Identify opportunities to improve tooling, governance and workflows while integrating emerging technologies.
- Mentor designers and foster excellence through coaching and knowledge sharing without direct disciplinary responsibility.

** **
What you bring
You hold a degree in Design or a related discipline combined with several years of experience leading large-scale design systems in complex product organizations. In addition to your experience in influencing multidisciplinary teams across Design, Engineering and Product you have following skills:

- Proven experience leading enterprise-scale design systems.
- Strong design leadership with the ability to influence without formal authority.
- Excellent interaction, visual and systems design skills.
- Technical fluency with design tokens, front-end frameworks and design tooling.
- Deep knowledge of accessibility and inclusive design.
- Strategic thinking aligned with business and product goals.
- Outstanding communication, facilitation and stakeholder management.
- Cross-functional leadership and change management capabilities.
- Fluent English; German is a plus.

Does this job sound like it was made for you? Then seize your opportunity and apply online.
Applicants with severe disabilities who are equally qualified will be given preferential consideration.
We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.occupation: Team Leader Medical Services Munich (m/f/d) (Facharzt/-ärztin - Arbeitsmedizin)
jobs.description:
- In your role als Team Leader of Medical Services Munich, providing disciplinary and functional leadership to your team (18 employees) while prioritizing diversity and our Leadership Next Level dimensions (Ambition, Responsibility, Empathy)
- Ensuring medical care in accordance with legal requirements, foster a supportive team environment, and optimize processes to enhance efficiency and digitalization
- Providing support during crises and offer guidance on mental health, BEM, and prevention
- Training and continuing education of physicians and non-medical staff, as well as quality assurance, personnel planning, and collaboration with professional associations
- Individual examinations in occupational and aviation medicine, vaccinations, and outpatient care round out your responsibilities

Ihr Profil:

- You have a degree in medicine with a German medical license and are a board-certified specialist in occupational medicine (m/f/d); additional qualifications, such as in internal/general medicine or aviation medicine, would be an advantage.
- You have at least 3–5 years of relevant professional experience and, ideally, leadership experience
- You stand out for your confident leadership, interdisciplinary thinking, strong commitment to innovation in the age of automation and AI, as well as your entrepreneurial acumen, strong communication skills, ability to manage conflicts, and excellent command of German and English

TYTAN Technologies

At TYTAN, we aim to set a global standard in autonomous air defense with AI-driven, cost-efficient systems that counter unmanned aerial threats at scale. We protect people. We protect critical infrastructure. We protect Europe’s sovereignty.

We are looking for a Business Systems Architect (m/f/d) to own and evolve the systems, tools, and processes that keep TYTAN running. As a company that designs and manufactures its own hardware and software, our operational landscape spans engineering, production, supply chain, and beyond, all of which need to be reflected in a coherent, well-connected tool and process architecture. With Odoo as our core ERP platform today, you will ensure our systems work seamlessly together, our processes are well-designed and continuously improving, and our digital landscape is ready for the next stage of growth.

You will work closely with teams across the organization to translate business needs into smart, scalable workflows, and then build them.

Systems Architecture & Roadmap

- Build and maintain the enterprise architecture across business capabilities, processes, data, and applications, building a lean digital thread from Requirements and Engineering through to Production and Service.
- Define and enforce standards across the stack: single source of truth, SSO, clean integrations, and compliance with ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and Export Control requirements.
- Anticipate when the current tool landscape needs to evolve, knowing when Odoo alone is not enough and when dedicated PLM, MES, or other systems are needed.

Odoo Development & Customization

- Configure, customize, and extend Odoo modules using Python to match evolving business needs, owning upgrades, testing, and deployment across environments.
- Ensure data integrity, security, and performance of the Odoo platform while managing integrations with tools across CRM, finance, project management, and communication.

Engineering, Production & Process

- Support and optimize workflows for BOM management, production planning, work orders, and quality control, ensuring system processes reflect how hardware and software are actually built.
- Work with stakeholders to map, document, and improve business processes eliminating bottlenecks, reducing manual workarounds, and maintaining documentation as the business evolves.
- Manage product lifecycle processes from prototyping and engineering changes through to serial production, while ensuring full traceability and documentation standards are met.

AI & Automation

- Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities from Odoo's built-in capabilities to third-party tools and custom solutions to reduce manual work and improve accuracy
- Stay current on emerging AI and automation technologies and bring relevant ideas to the table

Stellenanforderungen

- 3–5 years of experience with ERP systems, with hands-on Odoo experience strongly preferred
- Solid Python development skills and familiarity with Odoo's OWL framework for customization and module development
- Proven experience mapping, documenting, and improving business processes with a strong understanding of how sales, procurement, inventory, production, and finance translate into system workflows
- Background in a manufacturing, engineering, or hardware-building environment is a strong plus
- Experience building and maintaining integrations between business systems via APIs, middleware, or native connectors, you see the full landscape and know how the pieces fit together
- Familiarity with AI/ML tools and workflow automation platforms such as n8n, Make, or Zapier
- Awareness of ISO 27001, ISO 9001, and export control compliance in a systems context;
- Clear communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders; fluent in English, German is a plus

Why TYTAN?

- Build technology with real operational impact: Develop autonomous defence systems designed to protect lives and strengthen Europe’s security.
- Shape scalable defence capabilities: Work on solutions built for mass deployment, cost efficiency, resilience, and reliable production at scale.
- Contribute to networked air defence: Help integrate our systems into multi-layered defence architectures alongside sensors, command systems, and effectors.
- Develop for real-world operations: Build capabilities together with end users and improve them continuously based on direct operational feedback.
- Move fast and take ownership: Work in a focused, high-performance team where decisions are made quickly and individual contributions have immediate impact.
- Define a new generation of defence technology: Join early and help shape the products, engineering standards, culture, and direction of a fast-growing deep-tech company.
- Work with an international mission-driven team: Collaborate with experienced specialists united by the goal of creating sovereign and effective security capabilities for Europe.

Our Benefits

- Virtual stock options: Participate in our success through Virtual stock options (VSOPs) at the company's current valuation
- Monthly allowances: €106/month in flexible benefits including lunch discounts and EGYM Wellpass or shopping credit
- Regular health care events: Health check-ups, skin screenings, mental health workshops, and an annual vitamin infusion on us
- Referral bonus: Earn a reward when someone you refer joins the team
- Regular team events: On- and off-site activities to connect and celebrate together
- Corporate discounts: Exclusive employee discounts across a wide range of partner brands
- Flexibility: Flexible working hours and hybrid work model, plus a modern Munich office built for focus and collaboration

About us

At TYTAN, it is more than just a job; it is about embracing autonomy, personal growth, and purpose. Make a lasting impact in the new era of defense! Join us to create a safer world for all.

WE are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fairness and inclusivity. We do not prioritize any specific religion, gender, nationality, or background. Due to security clearance requirements, affiliations with countries listed under § 13 para. 1 no. 17 SÜG may affect the application process.

Please note that we currently do not offer visa sponsorship, so we’re only able to consider candidates who already have a valid work permit. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply.

jobs.description:
About the Company

CHN Energy Europe Research GmbH (CHEER) is a subsidiary of CHN Energy Investment Group (China Energy) based in Berlin, Germany. Being an integral part of China Energy’s globalized research and development layout, CHEER features in integrated European-Chinese innovation culture and advanced technology, and operates business in new energy technology research and development with purposes of promoting and accelerating carbon neutrality and making its own contribution in alleviating global climate change.

Centered on the green development strategy and the strategy of innovation-driven scientific and technological development, CHEER is committed to building a world-class research institute with global competitiveness. We focus on six key R&D areas: diversified power conversion, advanced chemical engineering, hydrogen energy, artificial intelligence, energy storage, and new environmental protection technologies.

We are building teams to develop cutting-edge sustainable and affordable technologies to improve energy efficiency, protect the environment, and mitigate climate change. Our ability to excel depends on the integrity, knowledge, skill, imagination, passion, and teamwork of people like you. Currently we have openings for leading experts with a range of focus areas including energy, chemistry, and artificial intelligence. We offer competitive compensation packages and excellent benefits.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Lead the development of the AI-based “Scientific Brain” research platform, including the overall construction of AI systems; apply large language models (LLMs) to design and optimize model architectures, carry out model training, and deploy the integrated AI platform.
2. Utilize robotic technologies to perform high-throughput experiments for the rapid synthesis and screening of a vast array of material candidates, accelerating the discovery of high-performance materials.
3. Analyze experimental data from material characterization techniques; correlate material properties with catalytic performance to guide the optimization of catalyst formulations and synthesis methods, thereby enhancing reaction efficiency.
4. Apply AI-driven computational modeling techniques to predict catalyst behavior at the atomic level; simulate adsorption, activation, and reaction pathways of reactants, identify promising catalyst candidates, and guide experimental work toward the most effective design directions.
5. Continuously explore and apply new AI algorithms and techniques to optimize predictive models and improve catalyst development strategies, thereby accelerating the discovery and optimization of advanced catalysts.

Qualification Requirements:

1. Master’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Software Engineering, Data Engineering, or a comparable technical field
2. Several years of relevant professional experience in AI system development, platform engineering, or a comparable field
3. Solid experience in developing AI systems or scalable platforms, with sound knowledge of distributed system architectures and large-scale data processing
4. Proficiency in Python, Java, or Go
5. Practical experience with common AI frameworks and infrastructure tools, such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, Kubernetes, and Docker
6. Good knowledge of SQL/NoSQL databases, cloud platforms (such as AWS or Azure), and containerized deployment technologies
7. Additional academic or professional background in Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or Chemical Engineering is considered an asset
8. Knowledge of or experience in energy, energy storage, or low-carbon technology applications is highly desirable
9. Very good English skills are required; German and/or Chinese is an advantage.

We Offer

- Competitive compensation and benefits: We offer an attractive compensation package based on the responsibilities of the role, the candidate’s qualifications, relevant professional experience, and overall fit. Additional benefits and supplementary payments may be granted in accordance with company policies and individual eligibility.
- Excellent research environment: Sufficient research funding and access to advanced digital tools and innovative technologies.
- Innovative workplace: Exciting and diverse tasks in an international R&D setting with a collaborative, open atmosphere.
- Room for creativity: Freedom to contribute your own ideas and actively shape forward-looking solutions in sustainable energy, technology, and organizational development.
- International collaboration: Interdisciplinary projects and partnerships with renowned academic and industry players across Europe, including opportunities for international exchange.
- Career development: Tailored training programs, individual career pathways, and support for participation in professional events and confe

This role supports assigned marketplace sellers from qualification and onboarding to activation, growth planning, and performance improvement.You will qualify offerings, build success plans, improve marketplace positioning, and support joint market engagement with Siemens teams. Using data, market insights, and seller feedback, you will help identify sales opportunities, improve activation, and turn platform participation into stronger pipeline, GMV contribution, and seller satisfaction.What we offer you

- An attractive remuneration package- 30 days of paid vacation and a variety of flexible work schedules that allow time off for you and your family- 2 to 3 days of mobile working per week as a global standard- Up to 30 days workation per year in certain countries- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions- Location-dependent childcare to help balance family and work

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here (https://www.siemens.com/de/en/company/jobs/benefits-what-we-offer.html) .

You’ll make an impact by

- Marketplace seller acquisition and offering fit- Identify and qualify high-potential marketplace sellers and offerings based on portfolio relevance, eCommerce readiness, growth potential, and ability to support Siemens Xcelerator use cases- Assess how external offerings connect with the Siemens digital portfolio and help shape value propositions that address concrete customer needs- Prepare onboarding and success planning input that translates seller ambitions into GMV assumptions, growth levers, and next actions
- Relationship management and sales activation- Manage assigned marketplace seller relationships as the primary success contact across onboarding, activation, and growth- Support sellers in improving listing quality, positioning, and marketplace readiness, and coordinate with Partner Management, Product Management, Marketing, Siemens sales teams, and Sales Units to activate go-to-market and co-sell opportunities- Engage with stakeholders to uncover new account and industry opportunities where marketplace offerings can create value
- Performance tracking and feedback- Track performance through pipeline development, new business generation, solution adoption, transaction activity, and GMV contribution- Use data and market insight to adjust success plans, prioritize high-impact actions, and support performance discussions with assigned sellers- Capture marketplace seller feedback to inform Product Management input, platform requirements, and benefits and rewards decisions based on achieved targets and marketplace activity

Your defining qualities

- Education- Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., Business, Marketing, or a related field); a Master's degree is a plus
- Experience & Skills- Several years of hands-on experience in sales, business development, partner success, marketplace seller success, or strategic account management in a B2B technology, software, SaaS, or digital platform environment- Proven ability to identify and qualify commercial opportunities, build success plans, and support joint sales activities within a partner ecosystem- Data-driven mindset, with experience using sales, pipeline, and marketplace insights to prioritize actions, forecast potential, and improve performance- Strong communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills, with the ability to manage multiple marketplace seller relationships and connect external portfolios with Siemens or comparable industrial technology propositions
- Ways of working- Hands-on mindset, taking ownership for delivering high-quality outcomes and contributing to an empowering team culture- Strong collaboration mindset across departments and organizational boundaries, adapting well to complexity and change with structure and pragmatism- Familiarity with technology company operating models is a plus, though not a requirement
- Languages: High proficiency in written and spoken English and German; additional languages are a plus

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES The What: At Blackwave GmbH, we develop and manufacture high-performance carbon fiber components for airplanes, rockets, and satellites — pushing the limits of lightweight design and precision manufacturing. Our mission: To end COPV failure in spaceflight. The benchmark for performance, reliability and cost efficiency.

The Why: Because quality is the foundation of innovation. Every component we deliver must perform flawlessly under extreme conditions — in the air, in orbit, and beyond. As part of our Quality team, you ensure that our processes meet the highest standards, enabling us to turn cutting-edge ideas into flight-ready solutions.

Important Note: This role is focused on Quality Assurance of our hardware (COPVs). We are not currently hiring for Software Quality Assurance positions

• Project & Process Quality Assurance: You define and implement quality assurance strategies across the entire product lifecycle - from suppliers and development to serial production.
• Manufacturing & Process Quality: You accompany production on the shop floor, working closely with manufacturing teams to ensure quality requirements are effectively implemented at all production stations.
• Change Control: You support product and process changes, ensure quality requirements are considered and contribute to approval and implementation activities.
• Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions: You analyze quality deviations using structured methods (e.g. 8D, Ishikawa, 5-Why), derive sustainable corrective actions, and ensure their implementation.
• Continuous Improvement & Audits: You monitor key quality indicators (e.g. audit findings, non-conformities) and proactively drive continuous improvement of processes and standards.

YOUR PROFILE
• Training & studies - You have completed degree in engineering, quality management, production technology, or a comparable qualification
• Professional experience - You have relevant experience in quality planning and risk management, ideally in a manufacturing environment
• Analytical Thinking & Root Cause Analysis: You are skilled at identifying patterns, isolating root causes (e.g. using 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa), and translating findings into actionable improvements
• Standards & Compliance Knowledge: You are familiar with applicable quality standards and their practical implementation, as well as experience with ISO9001
• Working Style & Mindset: You work independently, think in solutions, and enjoy deriving insights from quality data. You pursue excellence and value precision and reliability
• Language skills - Very good written and spoken English, German is also nice to have for collaboration between departments

WHAT WE OFFER
• Personal responsibility & creative freedom: You actively contribute to the further development of our production technologies.
• Flexible working hours & mobile working: Work-life balance is not an empty promise with us.
• Start-up spirit meets aerospace: flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes and room for innovation.
• Individual benefits: Choose between a Germany ticket, Egym-Wellpass or a tax-free benefit in kind with the Give Card.
• Fresh food every day: Shared lunch break with healthy, varied dishes.
• Alpine view included: Our roof terrace invites you to relax after work.
• Further development guaranteed: You will grow both professionally and personally through exciting projects and exchanges with experts.
• We live and breathe team culture: whether it's a tech talk, team event or after-work - we celebrate successes together.

About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

jobs.description:
With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers—and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Be part of Getinge as a

Quality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and Compliance

We are currently looking for an experienced Quality Management Engineer (m/f/d) QMS and Compliance to join our Quality department in Aschheim-Dornach, Germany, or Solna, Sweden, part of the Critical Care product area at Getinge. This role will support the organization as the internal audit process owner, CAPA coordinator, and QA specialist, while continuously improving our quality management system and supporting quality-related projects (e.g., implementation of new tools, CAPA, etc.).

Tasks & Responsibilities:

- Own the internal audit process, plan the annual internal audit schedule, and follow up on internal audit findings
- Conduct internal audits as an internal auditor
- Support of external audits (notified bodies, authorities, customers)
- Support of CAPA projects as CAPA coordinator
- Collaboration in and owning internal Quality projects (management system plan, CAPA)
- Continuous contribution to process improvement and alignment with other Critical Care sites
- Provision and reporting of monthly KPIs
- Maintenance, review and approval of QMS-related documentation and records as QA specialist

Desired Profile:

- Degree in medical technology, engineering, science, or a similar relevant field
- Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in quality and environmental management, ideally in an ISO 13485 environment
- Relevant knowledge of the implementation and application of applicable standards and regulations
- Proven external and/or internal training in QM / ISO 13485 / FDA / EU MDR
- Ideally trained as an Internal Auditor
- Demonstrated experience in Quality- and Environmental-related projects (e.g., CAPAs, EU MDR uplift) is an advantage
- Fluency in written and spoken English; Swedish or German (depending on the location) is an advantage
- On-site presence of at least 1–2 days per week is expected; willingness to travel is required

In addition to your technical expertise, we highly value your personality. We believe you are a result-oriented and collaborative team player who takes ownership of your work and can operate independently when needed. You have strong analytical skills, a pragmatic mindset, and the ability to build relationships with stakeholders across different functions, seniority levels, and cultures. You thrive in a changing environment and approach challenges with professionalism and diplomacy.

We think you have an ambition for continuous development and a strong interest in staying up to date with the latest trends, regulations, and best practices within Quality Management, Medical Devices, and Supplier Quality.

At Getinge, we see ourselves as Team Players, Forward Thinkers, and Game Changers. We value proactive individuals who contribute to continuous improvement and organizational development.

Why join Getinge

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including wellness allowances, generous family benefits, and joint company activities. Everything to ensure we support your well-being and goals.

Most importantly, this is a role where you can truly make a difference by contributing to the quality and safety of life-saving medical devices while helping shape the future of quality and compliance within Getinge.

Application

Applications will be reviewed continuously, and we therefore recommend submitting your application as soon as possible.

We kindly ask you to submit your application through our recruitment system by clicking the "Apply Now" button. Due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email.

About us

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing, and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide, and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.

Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.
